sanity_expectations: N_next is finite and real over the entire (N,T) sampling region with the given parameters
At T=Tref the thermal factor (1+g(T-Tref)) collapses to 1 and N_next reduces to the parent-equation value at the same N
For very small N the map is dominated by r*N (near-linear positive reproduction) minus the low-prey enemy escape residual
As N approaches 1 the Ricker (1-N) factor drives that term toward 0 while the Allee and enemy terms remain non-zero
For fixed N, increasing T above Tref monotonically increases predation magnitude, so N_next decreases
For fixed N, decreasing T below Tref decreases predation magnitude, so N_next increases
excitation_report: excitation_check (sigma=0.02, k=5, 512-point Sobol over N∈[0.01,2], T∈[5,30]): Allee term s*N^2/(a+N) at 23.8σ; enemy/temperature term -m*N*(1+wN/(c+N))*(1+g(T-Tref))/(b+N) at 23.0σ; Ricker term r*N*(1-N)*exp(-hN) at 22.3σ. NEW term (thermal modulation, i.e. child minus parent) peaks at 0.321 → 16.06σ, strongest at N≈1.88, T≈29.9 (upper end of both axes where enemy loss magnitude and |T-Tref| are largest). No weak terms; all visible.
role_corrections: N_next: O->O (confirmed dependent variable, explicit LHS)
N: mis-tagged 'time axis' -> V (independent sampling axis: current-generation abundance, the map's input)
T: mis-tagged 'time axis' -> V (independent sampling axis: external environmental driver, per pipeline range hint)
r: mis-tagged 'time axis' -> P (fixed intrinsic growth constant)
h: mis-tagged 'time axis' -> P (fixed crowding stress coefficient)
rationale: Static, explicitly-solvable expression with no derivatives or integrals → equation_type=explicit, integrator=evaluate_explicit. N_next is uniquely determined by (N, T) plus fixed parameters; a discrete-generation ecological map is sampled as (N,T) → N_next pairs on a 2D cloud, not time-integrated. Ranges honour pipeline hints: T∈[5,30], Tref=17.5 (mid-range), g=0.05 (mid of hinted [0,0.1]). N sampled on [0.01, 2] to include low-Allee regime, the (1-N)=0 crossing, and densities where enemy aggregation saturates; excluding N=0 keeps 1/(a+N)-style denominators clean while still exercising them. r=3, h=1 give a classical Ricker-like reproduction curve; s,a,m,b,w,c chosen to keep the three additive terms in comparable magnitude (all >22σ). Sanity check finite/real; auto_balance converged and excitation_check confirms every term and the new thermal-modulation term are visible above sigma=0.02 noise.
